subject: How to read HAP or BC1 population type in mapQTL format

messages.author: 755f9cca67993013
messages.subject: How to read HAP or BC1 population type in mapQTL format
parts:
Hello,

I tried to read HAP population type in the mapQTL format using read.cross() function, I got 'HAP population not supported yet' error. Then I re-coded the data file to BC1 population type, again I got same error 'BC1 not supported yet'. Both of the files are working well with mapQTL, so there is no issue with input files. Could someone please help me to read any of these population types into R/qtl? 


Thanks,
Ramesh

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] How to read HAP or BC1 population type in mapQTL format
parts:
At present, for the mapqtl format, only 4-way crosses are supported ("CP" type in MapQTL/JoinMap). So you’ll need to convert the data files to a different format.

sorry,
karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] How to read HAP or BC1 population type in mapQTL format
parts:
If you CP population is a cross between two outbred individuals, I would prefer to treat it as a phase-known 4-way cross ("4way"), but this requires inferring phase/haplotypes.

The genotype encoding is described in the help information for read.cross():

For a 4-way cross, the mother and father are assumed to have genotypes AB and CD, respectively. The genotype data for the progeny is assumed to be phase-known, with the following coding scheme: NA = missing, 1 = AC, 2 = BC, 3 = AD, 4 = BD, 5 = A = AC or AD, 6 = B = BC or BD, 7 = C = AC or BC, 8 = D = AD or BD, 9 = AC or BD, 10 = AD or BC, 11 = not AC, 12 = not BC, 13 = not AD, 14 = not BD.

karl
